name: Photo Storage Calculator
description: Estimate how many photos fit in a storage capacity based on average image file size.
search_intent: Calculate how many photos can fit on a memory card, phone, drive or cloud storage allowance.
calculation: Usable storage GB = storage GB × (1 - reservedPercent/100). Convert GB to MB using a clearly documented convention. Estimated photos = floor(usable storage MB / average photo MB). Return null when average photo size is zero or invalid.
limitations: Actual image sizes vary by camera, resolution, format, compression and scene complexity.
Real device capacity may differ because of formatting, operating-system use and manufacturer storage conventions.
